title: Glowing sun
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF8B0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFD740'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8F00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='outerGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD740' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8F00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Outer glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#outerGlow)'/>
  <!-- Sun rays -->
  <g stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='6' x2='50' y2='16'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='84' x2='50' y2='94'/>
    <line x1='6' y1='50' x2='16' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='50' x2='94' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='18.9' y1='18.9' x2='26' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='74' x2='81.1' y2='81.1'/>
    <line x1='81.1' y1='18.9' x2='74' y2='26'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='74' x2='18.9' y2='81.1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Extra rays -->
  <g stroke='#FFCA28' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='31' y1='9' x2='35' y2='18'/>
    <line x1='69' y1='9' x2='65' y2='18'/>
    <line x1='31' y1='91' x2='35' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='69' y1='91' x2='65' y2='82'/>
    <line x1='9' y1='31' x2='18' y2='35'/>
    <line x1='9' y1='69' x2='18' y2='65'/>
    <line x1='91' y1='31' x2='82' y2='35'/>
    <line x1='91' y1='69' x2='82' y2='65'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sun body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='26' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- Highlight -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='8' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Cute face: eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='48' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#E65100'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='48' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#E65100'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8B0'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8B0'/>
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d='M43 58 Q50 65 57 58' stroke='#E65100' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF7043' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='56' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF7043' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
